quests.quest_title: What is the clear usable width of this sidewalk (in feet)?
quests.quest_description: Measure the unobstructed pedestrian clear width of the sidewalk at a representative location on this segment.

quests.quest_title: What is the narrowest clear usable width on this sidewalk segment (in feet)?
quests.quest_description: Measure the narrowest unobstructed clear width on this segment, excluding temporary passersby.

quests.quest_title: What is the running slope of this sidewalk (percent)?
quests.quest_description: Record the uphill or downhill slope along the direction of travel as a percent.

quests.quest_title: What is the cross slope of this sidewalk (percent)?
quests.quest_description: Record the side-to-side slope across the walking surface as a percent.

quests.quest_title: What is the primary surface material of this sidewalk?
quests.quest_description: Select the primary walking-surface material for this segment.

quests.quest_title: What is the overall surface condition of this sidewalk?
quests.quest_description: Choose the overall condition of the walking surface for this segment.

quests.quest_title: Which surface defects are present on this sidewalk?
quests.quest_description: Select all observed defects that materially affect walking comfort, drainage, or accessibility.

quests.quest_title: Is there a sidewalk gap, missing connection, or forced detour on this segment?
quests.quest_description: Record whether this segment contains a break, discontinuity, or forced transition that interrupts continuous pedestrian travel.

quests.quest_title: Are there persistent obstructions on this sidewalk?
quests.quest_description: Record whether permanent or semi-permanent objects reduce the usable pedestrian space on this segment.

quests.quest_title: Which persistent obstructions are present on this sidewalk?
quests.quest_description: Select all permanent or semi-permanent obstructions that reduce usable width or create accessibility issues.

quests.quest_title: Which recurring temporary obstructions are present on this sidewalk?
quests.quest_description: Select all recurring but movable obstructions commonly observed on this segment.

quests.quest_title: What type of curb or edge condition borders this sidewalk along the roadway side?
quests.quest_description: Select the edge treatment that best describes the roadway-side edge of this sidewalk.

quests.quest_title: What type of separation exists between this sidewalk and the nearest motor-vehicle travel lane?
quests.quest_description: Select the primary separation feature between pedestrians and moving motor vehicles.

quests.quest_title: What is the approximate width of that separation (in feet)?
quests.quest_description: Measure or estimate the width between the sidewalk edge and the nearest motor-vehicle travel lane. Enter 0 if there is no separation.

quests.quest_title: How would you characterize observed lighting for this sidewalk?
quests.quest_description: Use this only when the observation can reasonably support a lighting assessment; otherwise choose 'Unable to assess in daytime'.

quests.quest_title: Is there meaningful shade along this sidewalk segment?
quests.quest_description: Record whether trees or built structures provide noticeable shade for pedestrians on this segment.

quests.quest_title: Is this path routinely cleared of snow, ice, leaves, or similar seasonal debris?
quests.quest_description: Use this only when seasonal maintenance practice is known or clearly posted.

quests.quest_title: What is the posted speed limit on the adjacent roadway (mph)?
quests.quest_description: Record the posted motor-vehicle speed limit for the roadway immediately adjacent to this sidewalk segment.

quests.quest_title: How many motor-vehicle travel lanes are adjacent to this sidewalk segment?
quests.quest_description: Count all general-purpose and turn lanes that a pedestrian is directly exposed to along this segment.

quests.quest_title: Is this crossing marked on the roadway?
quests.quest_description: Record whether the crossing is visibly marked with pavement markings.

quests.quest_title: What type of crossing markings are present?
quests.quest_description: Select all marking styles present at this crossing.

quests.quest_title: What is the condition of the crossing markings?
quests.quest_description: Assess the visibility and completeness of the markings.

quests.quest_title: What is the crossing distance from curb to curb (in feet)?
quests.quest_description: Measure or estimate the pedestrian crossing distance from one curb line or landing edge to the other.

quests.quest_title: What is the posted speed limit on the roadway being crossed (mph)?
quests.quest_description: Record the posted motor-vehicle speed limit for the roadway associated with this crossing.

quests.quest_title: How many motor-vehicle travel lanes are being crossed here?
quests.quest_description: Count all through lanes and turn lanes a pedestrian must cross.

quests.quest_title: Is there a refuge island or median that can be used while crossing?
quests.quest_description: Record whether a pedestrian refuge island or median is present and usable.

quests.quest_title: What is the primary surface material of the refuge island or median?
quests.quest_description: Select the primary pedestrian surface material on the refuge island or median.

quests.quest_title: What type of traffic control serves this crossing?
quests.quest_description: Select the traffic-control condition that governs this crossing.

quests.quest_title: Does this crossing have a pedestrian pushbutton?
quests.quest_description: Record whether a pushbutton is present to request or actuate a pedestrian crossing phase.

quests.quest_title: Is the pushbutton reachable and usable by a person using a mobility device?
quests.quest_description: Assess whether the pushbutton can be reached and used from an accessible landing area.

quests.quest_title: Is an audible pedestrian signal present?
quests.quest_description: Record whether the crossing provides an audible indication of the walk phase.

quests.quest_title: Is a vibrotactile pedestrian indication present?
quests.quest_description: Record whether the crossing provides a vibrotactile indication of the walk phase.

quests.quest_title: Is a tactile arrow present on the pedestrian signal device?
quests.quest_description: Record whether the pedestrian signal device includes a tactile directional arrow.

quests.quest_title: If present, is the tactile arrow aligned with the actual direction of travel?
quests.quest_description: Assess alignment only when a tactile arrow is present and the crossing direction is clear.

quests.quest_title: Is tactile warning paving present at the crossing landing?
quests.quest_description: Record whether detectable warning surface is present at the landing serving this crossing.

quests.quest_title: What is the width of the tactile warning surface (in inches)?
quests.quest_description: Measure the width of the tactile warning surface across the landing.

quests.quest_title: What is the depth of the tactile warning surface (in inches)?
quests.quest_description: Measure the depth of the tactile warning surface from back edge toward the street.

quests.quest_title: What type of tactile warning surface is present?
quests.quest_description: Select the tactile warning pattern that best matches what is installed.

quests.quest_title: Are curb ramps or blended transitions present at both ends of the crossing?
quests.quest_description: Record whether each end of the crossing connects to an accessible curb ramp or blended transition.

quests.quest_title: How many seconds of pedestrian crossing time are provided?
quests.quest_description: If signalized, record the observed or posted pedestrian clearance time in seconds.

quests.quest_title: What is the observed pedestrian wait time before the walk phase begins (seconds)?
quests.quest_description: If signalized and observed, record the time from arrival to walk indication in seconds.

quests.quest_title: Is a stop bar present for approaching vehicles?
quests.quest_description: Record whether a stop bar is marked for vehicles approaching this crossing.

quests.quest_title: What is the approximate distance from the stop bar to the crossing line (in feet)?
quests.quest_description: Measure or estimate the setback between the stop bar and the crossing.

quests.quest_title: How visible are pedestrians to approaching drivers at this crossing?
quests.quest_description: Rate visibility based on sight lines, parked cars, vegetation, curvature, and other obstructions.

quests.quest_title: How often do approaching drivers yield to pedestrians when yielding is required?
quests.quest_description: Record the observed yielding pattern during the audit window.

quests.quest_title: Is there another safe crossing within reasonable walking distance of this location?
quests.quest_description: Use nearby conditions to estimate whether a safer or controlled crossing is available without an excessive detour.

quests.quest_title: What type of curb condition is present here?
quests.quest_description: Select the curb condition that best matches the observed edge transition.

quests.quest_title: If lowered, what type of lowered transition is this?
quests.quest_description: Differentiate a conventional curb ramp from a blended transition when the curb is lowered.

quests.quest_title: What is the ramp placement type?
quests.quest_description: Identify the geometric placement of the curb ramp when a curb ramp is present.

quests.quest_title: Does the curb ramp align with the crossing direction?
quests.quest_description: Assess whether the ramp directs a pedestrian toward the intended crossing path.

quests.quest_title: Does the curb ramp have edge protection?
quests.quest_description: Record whether vertical or structural edge protection is present where needed.

quests.quest_title: What is the curb height here (in inches)?
quests.quest_description: Measure the curb reveal or vertical curb height at this location.

quests.quest_title: What is the clear width of the curb ramp (in inches)?
quests.quest_description: Measure the clear usable width of the curb ramp between flares or barriers.

quests.quest_title: What is the running slope of the curb ramp (percent)?
quests.quest_description: Measure the maximum slope along the direction of travel on the curb ramp.

quests.quest_title: What is the cross slope of the curb ramp (percent)?
quests.quest_description: Measure the maximum side-to-side slope across the curb ramp.

quests.quest_title: What is the landing width at the top of the ramp (in inches)?
quests.quest_description: Measure the width of the top landing serving the curb ramp.

quests.quest_title: What is the landing depth at the top of the ramp (in inches)?
quests.quest_description: Measure the depth of the top landing serving the curb ramp.

quests.quest_title: What is the maximum side flare slope (percent)?
quests.quest_description: Measure the side flare slope where a side flare is present.

quests.quest_title: What is the gutter slope immediately in front of the ramp (percent)?
quests.quest_description: Measure the gutter or street slope that affects access to the base of the ramp.

quests.quest_title: What is the primary surface material of the curb ramp or transition?
quests.quest_description: Select the primary surface material of the accessible transition.

quests.quest_title: What is the overall condition of this curb ramp or transition surface?
quests.quest_description: Assess the overall condition of the accessible transition surface.

quests.quest_title: Which defects are present on this curb ramp or transition?
quests.quest_description: Select all defects that materially affect accessibility or drainage.

quests.quest_title: Is detectable warning / tactile paving present?
quests.quest_description: Record whether tactile warning surface is present at this curb ramp or transition.

quests.quest_title: What is the width of the tactile paving (in inches)?
quests.quest_description: Measure the width of the tactile warning surface across the landing edge.

quests.quest_title: What is the depth of the tactile paving (in inches)?
quests.quest_description: Measure the depth of the tactile warning surface from back edge toward the street.

quests.quest_title: What color is the tactile paving?
quests.quest_description: Record the predominant installed color of the tactile warning surface.

quests.quest_title: What tactile paving pattern is present?
quests.quest_description: Select the tactile warning pattern that best matches what is installed.

quests.quest_title: Is there a physical bus stop sign or flag at this stop?
quests.quest_description: Record whether a physical sign or flag identifies this location as a bus stop.

quests.quest_title: What type of sign or flag is present?
quests.quest_description: Select the sign or flag type that best describes the stop marker.

quests.quest_title: Is the stop sign or flag positioned so that the boarding area remains clear?
quests.quest_description: Assess whether the stop marker placement interferes with boarding, landing pad use, or pedestrian circulation.

quests.quest_title: Is an accessible boarding area or landing pad present at this stop?
quests.quest_description: Record whether a distinct level boarding area or landing pad is present and usable.

quests.quest_title: What is the boarding area width (in inches)?
quests.quest_description: Measure the clear width of the boarding area or landing pad.

quests.quest_title: What is the boarding area depth (in inches)?
quests.quest_description: Measure the clear depth of the boarding area or landing pad.

quests.quest_title: What is the boarding area cross slope (percent)?
quests.quest_description: Measure the cross slope of the boarding area surface.

quests.quest_title: What is the boarding area running slope (percent)?
quests.quest_description: Measure the slope of the boarding area parallel to the curb or direction of travel.

quests.quest_title: What is the curb height at this stop (in inches)?
quests.quest_description: Measure the curb height at the primary bus boarding point.

quests.quest_title: Is the curb and boarding condition suitable for ramp deployment or kneeling-bus operation?
quests.quest_description: Assess whether the observed curb and boarding condition appears compatible with ramp deployment or kneeling-bus boarding.

quests.quest_title: What shelter condition is present at this stop?
quests.quest_description: Select the shelter condition that best describes what is installed at the stop.

quests.quest_title: If present, what is the shelter condition?
quests.quest_description: Assess the shelter's physical condition and usability.

quests.quest_title: Is seating present at this stop?
quests.quest_description: Record whether any intentional or informal seating is available for riders.

quests.quest_title: What type of seating is present?
quests.quest_description: Select all seating types available at this stop.

quests.quest_title: How would you characterize observed lighting at this stop?
quests.quest_description: Use this only when the observation can reasonably support a lighting assessment; otherwise choose 'Unable to assess in daytime'.

quests.quest_title: Is schedule or real-time information posted or displayed at this stop?
quests.quest_description: Record whether riders can access any posted or displayed schedule information at this location.

quests.quest_title: What schedule or information formats are present?
quests.quest_description: Select all schedule and rider-information formats available at this stop.

quests.quest_title: If present, does the posted schedule information appear current and accurate?
quests.quest_description: Assess only when schedule information is present and legible.

quests.quest_title: Is a waste bin present at this stop?
quests.quest_description: Record whether a waste bin is available within the immediate stop waiting area.

quests.quest_title: How close is the nearest publicly accessible restroom?
quests.quest_description: Estimate restroom proximity that would be meaningful for a transit rider using this stop.

quests.quest_title: Is there an accessible passenger drop-off or pick-up location near this stop?
quests.quest_description: Record whether a nearby curbside or off-street location could reasonably serve accessible pick-up or drop-off.

quests.quest_title: What type of pedestrian connection links this stop to the surrounding pedestrian network?
quests.quest_description: Select the primary pedestrian connection from the stop boarding area to the surrounding network.

quests.quest_title: What type of bicycle connection is available near this stop?
quests.quest_description: Select the primary bicycle facility that provides direct multimodal access to this stop, if any.

quests.quest_title: How close is the nearest safe pedestrian crossing serving this stop?
quests.quest_description: Estimate proximity to the nearest crossing that a typical rider could use to access the opposite side of the roadway.

quests.quest_title: What type of separation exists between riders waiting at this stop and moving motor vehicles?
quests.quest_description: Select the primary separation feature between the waiting area and the nearest motor-vehicle travel lane.

quests.quest_title: What is the approximate width of that separation (in feet)?
quests.quest_description: Measure or estimate the width between the waiting area edge and the nearest motor-vehicle travel lane. Enter 0 if there is no separation.

quests.quest_title: What is the posted speed limit on the adjacent roadway (mph)?
quests.quest_description: Record the posted motor-vehicle speed limit at this stop.

quests.quest_title: How many motor-vehicle travel lanes are adjacent to this stop?
quests.quest_description: Count all through lanes and turn lanes that riders are directly exposed to while waiting or accessing the stop.

quests.quest_title: Which roadway design features are present near this stop?
quests.quest_description: Select all nearby roadway features that may affect transit access, safety, or reliability.

quests.quest_title: Is meaningful shade available in the stop waiting area?
quests.quest_description: Record whether trees or structures provide noticeable shade to riders waiting at the stop.

quests.quest_title: What type of control governs this intersection?
quests.quest_description: Select the traffic-control condition that best describes this intersection.

quests.quest_title: Is a pedestrian pushbutton present at this intersection?
quests.quest_description: Record whether a pushbutton is provided for at least one pedestrian movement at this intersection.

quests.quest_title: Is the pushbutton reachable and usable by a person using a mobility device?
quests.quest_description: Assess reachability and usable landing only when a pushbutton is present.

quests.quest_title: Are accessible pedestrian signal features present?
quests.quest_description: Record whether audible, vibrotactile, locator-tone, or tactile-arrow APS features are present.

quests.quest_title: Which APS features are present?
quests.quest_description: Select all APS features observed at this intersection.

quests.quest_title: What pedestrian clearance or crossing time is provided (seconds)?
quests.quest_description: If known or observable, record the pedestrian clearance or crossing interval in seconds.

quests.quest_title: Is a stop bar present for approaching vehicles?
quests.quest_description: Record whether a stop bar is marked for one or more approaches serving pedestrian crossings at this intersection.

quests.quest_title: What is the approximate stop-bar setback from the crossing line (in feet)?
quests.quest_description: Measure or estimate the distance from the stop bar to the nearest crossing line for the relevant approach.

quests.quest_title: How many motor-vehicle travel lanes are present on the primary approach being assessed?
quests.quest_description: Count all through lanes and turn lanes on the primary approach relevant to pedestrian crossing exposure.

quests.quest_title: What is the posted speed limit on the primary approach (mph)?
quests.quest_description: Record the posted motor-vehicle speed limit on the approach most relevant to pedestrian exposure.

quests.quest_title: Is a median or refuge space present that assists pedestrians crossing at this intersection?
quests.quest_description: Record whether a refuge space or median is available for staged crossings.

quests.quest_title: Which visibility obstructions materially affect pedestrian-driver sight lines at this intersection?
quests.quest_description: Select all observed features that reduce mutual visibility.
